newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed weaker at 3.10 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed weaker at 3.10 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1210 to the dollar, down from 3.1105 on Thursday and at 1.8100 to the mark, up from 1.8125, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.10 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Thursday's 3.20 percent fix.
According to the floating parity rate, which changes along with intraday currency moves on world markets, the zloty was fixed at 3.09 percent from parity, against Thursday's 3.22.
